Results of the image-level test on diabetesData

Source: R/data.R
spicyTest.Rd

The result of spicy(diabetesData, condition = "stage", subject = "case", method = "image"): the original image-level test of spicyR, for all pairs of cell types, comparing the onset and long-duration stages with non-diabetic donors. It is used in examples, so that they run quickly.

Usage

data("spicyTest")

Format

A SpicyResults object (see spicy).

Source

Made by inst/scripts/make-spicyTest.R from diabetesData.

Examples

data("spicyTest")
topPairs(spicyTest, n = 5)
#>                  intercept coefficient      p.value adj.pvalue  from    to
